tasks.label: Check OpenMemory Status
args: try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod http://localhost:8080/health -TimeoutSec 2; Write-Host '✅ OpenMemory is running' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host "   Provider: $($r.embedding.provider)" -ForegroundColor Gray } catch { Write-Host '❌ OpenMemory is not running' -ForegroundColor Red; Write-Host '   Run task: Start OpenMemory AI Memory' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

tasks.label: Stop OpenMemory
args: $processes = Get-Process -Name node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -like '*OpenMemory*' }; if ($processes) { $processes | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.Id -Force }; Write-Host '✅ OpenMemory stopped' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '⚠️  No OpenMemory process found' -ForegroundColor Yellow }
